sentences.en: I owe you a sincere apology for missing your birthday dinner last week, which I know you spent a lot of time planning for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我欠你一個真誠的道歉，因為我錯過了你上週的生日晚餐，我知道你花了很多時間為大家計劃。

sentences.en: Words cannot adequately express how grateful I am for everything you've done to help me get through this incredibly difficult period.
sentences.zh: 言語無法充分表達我對你所做的一切有多感激，你幫助我度過了這段極為困難的時期。

sentences.en: I'm deeply sorry for the hurtful things I said during our argument, none of which I actually meant, and I hope you can forgive me.
sentences.zh: 我為爭吵時說的那些傷人的話深感抱歉，那些都不是我真正的意思，我希望你能原諒我。

sentences.en: The kindness you showed me when I was at my lowest point is something I will never forget for as long as I live.
sentences.zh: 在我最低潮的時候你對我展現的善意，是我一輩子都不會忘記的事。

sentences.en: I realize that my careless behavior caused you a great deal of stress, and I take full responsibility for not being more considerate.
sentences.zh: 我意識到我粗心的行為給你造成了很大的壓力，我完全負責沒有更加體貼這件事。

sentences.en: Thank you from the bottom of my heart for staying up all night to help me prepare for the most important presentation of my career.
sentences.zh: 從心底感謝你整夜未眠幫助我準備我職業生涯中最重要的簡報。

sentences.en: I should have told you about the change of plans much earlier, and I genuinely regret the confusion and inconvenience it caused you.
sentences.zh: 我應該更早告訴你計劃的改變，我真心後悔這給你造成的困惑和不便。

sentences.en: Your generous donation to our organization has made it possible for dozens of underprivileged students to continue their education this year.
sentences.zh: 你對我們組織的慷慨捐款使得數十名弱勢學生今年能夠繼續接受教育。

sentences.en: I feel terrible about accidentally breaking your grandmother's vase, which I know held tremendous sentimental value for your entire family.
sentences.zh: 我對不小心打破你祖母的花瓶感到很糟糕，我知道它對你整個家庭有著極大的情感價值。

sentences.en: The mentorship you provided during my first year at this company shaped me into the professional I am today, and I'm eternally grateful.
sentences.zh: 你在我進公司第一年提供的指導塑造了今天的我這個專業人士，我永遠感激。

sentences.en: Please forgive me for not being there when you needed me most — I had no idea you were going through such a difficult time.
sentences.zh: 請原諒我在你最需要我的時候不在——我不知道你正在經歷如此困難的時期。

sentences.en: I cannot thank you enough for recommending me for that position, because without your endorsement, I never would have gotten the interview.
sentences.zh: 我無法充分感謝你推薦我那個職位，因為沒有你的推薦，我永遠不會得到面試機會。

sentences.en: Looking back, I realize how unfair I was to blame you for something that was entirely my own fault, and I'm truly sorry.
sentences.zh: 回頭看，我意識到把完全是我自己的錯怪到你頭上是多麼不公平，我真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: The time and effort you invested in teaching me how to cook my mother's recipes means more to me than you could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 你投入時間和心力教我如何做我母親的食譜，對我的意義比你可能想像的還要大。

sentences.en: I want to apologize not just for what happened yesterday, but for the pattern of behavior that led to it, which I'm actively working to change.
sentences.zh: 我想道歉的不只是昨天發生的事，還有導致它的行為模式，我正在積極努力改變。

sentences.en: Your willingness to forgive me after what I did demonstrates a level of grace and maturity that I deeply admire and aspire to.
sentences.zh: 在我做了那件事之後你願意原諒我，展現了我深深佩服和嚮往的優雅和成熟。

sentences.en: I'm so grateful that you took the time to write such a thoughtful recommendation letter, especially considering how busy your schedule has been.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你花時間寫了如此用心的推薦信，特別是考慮到你的行程有多忙碌。

sentences.en: It was incredibly thoughtless of me to share your personal information without asking first, and I completely understand if you're upset with me.
sentences.zh: 我沒有先問就分享你的個人資訊是極為不體貼的，我完全理解如果你對我生氣。

sentences.en: The surprise farewell party you organized for me, complete with all my favorite people and foods, brought me to tears of happiness.
sentences.zh: 你為我組織的驚喜歡送會，有我所有喜歡的人和食物，讓我感動得流下了幸福的眼淚。

sentences.en: I acknowledge that my tardiness has been a recurring issue, and I want you to know that I'm taking concrete steps to improve my time management.
sentences.zh: 我承認我的遲到一直是個反覆出現的問題，我想讓你知道我正在採取具體步驟改善時間管理。

sentences.en: Thank you for believing in me when I didn't believe in myself — your confidence gave me the courage to pursue something I'd always dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 感謝你在我不相信自己時相信我——你的信心給了我勇氣去追求我一直夢想的事。

sentences.en: I owe my entire team an apology for losing my temper during the meeting, which was unprofessional and created an uncomfortable atmosphere for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我欠整個團隊一個道歉，因為我在會議中發了脾氣，那很不專業，也為每個人創造了不舒服的氛圍。

sentences.en: The handwritten thank-you note you sent after our meeting was such a lovely gesture that it brightened my entire week.
sentences.zh: 你在我們見面後寄的手寫感謝函是如此美好的舉動，它照亮了我整個星期。

sentences.en: I'm profoundly sorry for the misunderstanding that arose from my poorly worded email, which was never intended to cause offense.
sentences.zh: 我為我措辭不當的電子郵件引起的誤解深感抱歉，它從來不是要冒犯人的。

sentences.en: Without your unwavering support during my recovery, I honestly don't know how I would have found the strength to keep going.
sentences.zh: 如果沒有你在我康復期間堅定不移的支持，我真的不知道我要如何找到力量繼續下去。

sentences.en: I regret that my actions may have damaged the trust between us, and I want you to know that rebuilding it is my top priority.
sentences.zh: 我後悔我的行為可能損害了我們之間的信任，我想讓你知道重建它是我的首要任務。

sentences.en: The fact that you drove three hours in the rain just to be at my graduation ceremony shows the kind of incredible friend you truly are.
sentences.zh: 你在雨中開了三小時的車只為了參加我的畢業典禮，展現了你是多麼了不起的朋友。

sentences.en: I want to sincerely apologize for forgetting our anniversary — there is absolutely no excuse, and I promise to make it up to you.
sentences.zh: 我想真誠地為忘記我們的紀念日道歉——絕對沒有藉口，我保證會補償你的。

sentences.en: Your generous offer to watch my children while I was in the hospital was a lifeline that I will always remember with deep appreciation.
sentences.zh: 你在我住院時慷慨地提出照顧我的孩子，是一條救命繩，我會永遠帶著深深的感激記住。

sentences.en: I hope you can accept my apology not merely as words, but as a genuine commitment to being more thoughtful and considerate going forward.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能接受我的道歉，不僅僅是言語，而是一個真正的承諾，未來會更加體貼和考慮周到。
